results.title: Congo, Algeria become 8th and 9th African teams to make the World Cup round of 32 | AP News
results.snippet:
【公開日時: 2026-06-28T08:00:03】
Africa had a historic 10 nations qualify for the 2026 World Cup. After Congo’s 3-1 victory over Uzbekistan and Algeria’s stunning 3-3 draw against Austria on Saturday night, nine are headed to the knockout stage.
